ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefits_summary: Comprehensive crop insurance against natural calamities, pests, and diseases at very low farmer premium (2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi, 5% for commercial crops).
exclusions: Crop losses caused by war, nuclear risks, or malicious damage
documents_required: Land Possession Certificate / Khasra paper or Tenancy Agreement
application_steps: Apply on pmfby.gov.in, through your crop loan bank, or at a Common Service Centre (CSC) before the seasonal cut-off date.
Pay the nominal 1.5% to 2% farmer share premium.
Report any localized crop loss within 72 hours via the Crop Insurance App.
